description: This file defines classes and functions related to monitoring gauges in the c10::monitor namespace, including interfaces for gauge backends, a gauge handle class, and a macro for static gauge instances.

classes.name: GaugeImpl
classes.description: Forward declaration of internal gauge implementation class.

classes.name: GaugeBackendIf
classes.description: Interface for gauge backend implementations, with a method to record gauge values.

classes.name: GaugeBackendFactoryIf
classes.description: Interface for factory classes to create gauge backend instances.

classes.name: GaugeHandle
classes.description: Class representing a handle to a gauge, allowing recording of gauge values.

methods.name: GaugeBackendIf::~GaugeBackendIf
methods.description: Virtual destructor for gauge backend interface.

methods.name: GaugeBackendIf::record
methods.description: Records a value to the gauge backend.

methods.name: GaugeBackendFactoryIf::~GaugeBackendFactoryIf
methods.description: Virtual destructor for gauge backend factory interface.

methods.name: GaugeBackendFactoryIf::create
methods.description: Creates a new gauge backend instance given a key.

methods.name: GaugeHandle::GaugeHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gauge handle with a key.

methods.name: GaugeHandle::record
methods.description: Records a value to the gauge via the handle.
